run_CommonGen_main: run the CommonGen module to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_CommonGen_dataset: create a CommonGen dataset instance that loads the common_gen HuggingFace dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of concept and target tuples grouped by concept set index
load_common_gen_dataset: load the common_gen dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the CommonGen dataset with a specified seed
